programme.title: The Scent of the Night
programme.desc: Remo is a young policeman but also the leader of a group of robbers in the extreme Roman suburbs, specialised in assaulting the uptown. programme.title: Quinto: non ammazzare

programme.desc: Commendatore Ercole Cubetti, having given his son Mario a luxurious car for his promotion, discovers to his great regret that his son has cheated him and, instead of being promoted, has been sent back.

programme.title: Who Finds a Friend Finds a Treasure
programme.desc: Alan, a gambler, drains his uncle's savings and takes refuge on Charlie's boat, on a cruise. They shipwreck on an island, defend a tribe from pirates and discover a Japanese fort with treasure. In the end, the money turns out to be fake and Alan forgets a diamond idol, later exhibited in a museum where they are both hired as labourers.

programme.title: Crime of Love
programme.desc: The beautiful Carmela, a girl of Sicilian descent who arrived in the North with her parents, falls in love with the Milanese Nullo, a work colleague. programme.desc: Rocco Papaleo, an optimistic and kind man from a mining town in Alaska, gets away from his company during a trip to Chicago and is increasingly disillusioned in the face of the city's hostility.

programme.title: Three Men And a Ghost
programme.desc: Three friends to whom fortune has never smiled attempt to win an all-inclusive weekend at a lavish 18th-century villa.
